title: First steps: two small functions
description:
A two-problem practice assignment that shows how assignments work in mylab.

Open each starter file, replace the placeholder line with your own code, then press **Check my answers**. You can check as often as you like.

problems.title: Area of a rectangle
problems.prompt:
Write a function

```matlab
a = rect_area(w, h)
```

that returns the area of a rectangle with width `w` and height `h`.

- `w` and `h` may be single numbers or arrays of the same size.
- When they are arrays, return the area for each pair.

| w | h | area |
|---|---|------|
| 3 | 4 | 12   |
| 2.5 | 2 | 5  |

problems.title: Average score from a file
problems.prompt:
The file `scores.csv` holds one row per student: a student number, then a score.

Write a function

```matlab
m = mean_score(filename)
```

that reads the file and returns the average of the scores (the second column).

Hint: `readmatrix(filename)` returns the numbers in the file as a matrix.
